dependency_207.body:
HU100 was badly undertrained at 39.4M nodes. Fresh unchanged-recipe training on the free **M4 (10 cores, 16 GB)** reached **1,000,002,065 nodes / 41,010,014 entries**, followed by a fixed paired comparison with the exact parent.

The campaign uses #206's compact table and **110 B/entry + 100 MB**, with a 57,658,644-entry ceiling, 6 GiB soft / 8 GiB hard family limits, and pressure, swap, disk and AC guards. Every 100M, 250M, 500M and 1B checkpoint receives streaming exports and a full audit. Both specified SHA256 gates pass. Native trainer source, old campaign scripts, recipe, menus and abstractions are unchanged.

Before final play, the timing-only pilot froze **2,048 swapped-seat blocks per opponent and policy** on fresh roots checked against every prior HU100 schedule. Only terminal minus parent against tight and loose aggressive opponents forms the primary family, with 97.5% intervals each. Terminal translation on minus off against pot_pressure is a separate 95% secondary. Other opponents and checkpoints are descriptive. There was no extension, pooling or checkpoint selection.

Loose-aggressive gain **+214.39 [122.28, 306.51] BB/100** improves; tight **+37.05 [−15.00, 89.10]** is inconclusive. Separate pot translation gain **+62.45 [17.15, 107.76]** improves; translation-off pot still loses. All **143,360 distinct final hands / 957,490 stored actions** replay and reproduce. Main training and saves took 15.38 minutes at 3.56 GiB sampled family peak, below the 4.29 GiB terminal forecast. Exports and audits took about 58 minutes; final play, replay and reproduction took 31.48 minutes. The measured **5h19 upper campaign quote** and final-stage 8,703-second allowance were posted before final play. Independent source and end evidence reviews pass with no open findings. Original qualification passed 70 Python and 11 Rust tests; all 12 final focused campaign tests pass.

After science completed, the first archive attempt breached the original 512 MiB swap-growth guard. Cleanup then raised PermissionError and suppressed its receipt. The failure logs, fixed baseline and latch, all originals and the 3,354,661,317-byte synced partial remain preserved. The owner authorized an archive-only retry allowing 3 GB swap. The repair conservatively capped **total swap at 3,000,000,000 bytes**, kept every other guard, restricted readmission to archive operations, and repaired receipt cleanup. The new exclusive ZIP passes **all 948 member size/SHA256 readbacks** in 120.42 seconds: **20,517,119,304 bytes**, SHA256 **ba3e82d8fa79be32d445c54eb240069c4a717cb75af9713f3eaf7ac86364fddf**. Maximum total swap was 1.684 GB; minimum disk was 23.81 GiB.

End review caught an unsupported inference from an absent native conflict field. The repaired single status check uses the documented Foundation file-version API, verifies zero unresolved versions and checks reported upload errors. The owner then explicitly instructed **start the Drive upload without waiting; they will verify upload and hashes before deleting originals**. Native status confirms upload started. **Cloud archive ID/metadata acceptance and remote-byte verification remain pending and are not claimed.** All originals remain, with no campaign waiter, agent deletion, synced eviction or other-PR cleanup.

[Protocol and measured budgets](docs/native-hu100-growth-1b.md), [report](docs/reports/native-hu100-growth-1b.md), [archive, hashes and restoration index](RESULTS_INDEX.md#pr207-hu100-1b-verified-science-and-local-archive-owner-upload-handoff--october-9). This is one seed and a scripted pool, with no general-strength, external benchmark, policy-default, release or tag claim. ROADMAP records the result. Merge only after the final exact-head checks pass with no open findings.
